fieldValues.title: Which problem carries the need to select by relation?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (2. Documents need to select records by relation), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. SP-24, what a query or view returns is opaque.
- B. SP-48, links between records are hidden.
- C. A new problem stated for selection by relation itself (srs-rust#1413 notes none is affirmed).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether the people who feel it describe opacity, hidden links, or something neither names.
fieldValues.next_action: Read the vignettes and findings in the graph thread's second part against SP-24 and SP-48 and see what neither covers.
